title: s500-literature-171: Working-memory gating task iEEG, epoched bipolar ECoG/sEEG from 11 patients with Yeo-7 network labels (Johnson et al., 2023) (derivative)
description: Epoched, bipolar-referenced intracranial EEG (ECoG/sEEG) from 11 neurosurgical epilepsy patients performing a single-trial working-memory gating task with context-first and context-last conditions. This derivative repackages the authors' filtered, artifact-cleaned FieldTrip epochs from OSF into BIDS, with trial information as events, electrode positions, and Yeo-7 network labels where mappable. It supports study of theta network mechanisms in flexible information encoding.
methods_description: Authors' preprocessed epochs (filtered, artifact-cleaned, bipolar-referenced channels) were converted from FieldTrip structs to BrainVision float32 with trials concatenated. Trial info fields were written to events.tsv and electrode positions (chanpos) to electrodes files. Channel types were inferred from bipolar pair numbering following the article's montage rule.
